title: Copilot Studio: web browsing for agents on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: Hold: the credit-allocation API entry omits the request body needed to configure an environment or disable tenant-pool draw. The claim that cost controls are the only confirmed controls for this harness is also incorrect: Microsoft documents authoring, data-access and sharing controls.

claims.claim: The printed PUT call with the parenthetical entitlementId and enforcement-rule names configures environment credits and tenant-pool draw.
claims.fix: The endpoint, PUT method and version exist, but replace the parenthetical pseudo-call with the complete request: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01; Authorization: Bearer <access-token>; Content-Type: application/json; body {"scope":{"environmentId":"<environment-id>"},"allocatedEntitlements":[{"entitlementId":"MCSMessages","allocation":{"quantity":<credits>},"enforcementRules":[{"ruleType":"TenantPool","enabled":false}]}]}. Use the cited tutorial's authentication prerequisites. The current entry supplies neither the environment nor allocation quantity nor the required enabled value.

claims.claim: Cost controls are the only documented levers confirmed for the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.quote: Admins govern it with four kinds of control: who can build agents, how much an agent can spend, what data and connectors it can reach, and who it can be shared with.
claims.fix: Replace 'The cost controls are the only documented levers confirmed for this harness. They cap spend, not where an agent browses.' with 'The cost controls listed here limit consumption, not browsing destinations.' This removes the false exclusion of the harness's documented authoring, data-access and sharing controls without claiming those controls govern native browsing.
